name: riemann-map
description: Research-grade Riemann-map / conformal-mapping studio. A new suite app (separate app per CLAUDE.md decision 8) built on the shared @cas/* packages: custom φ via @cas/expr (JS+GLSL), the WebGL2/colormap substrate via @cas/gpu, figure export via @cas/export, and map hand-off + permalinks via @cas/interchange (it imports another tool's conformal map rather than computing dynamics itself).
author: Andrew Graven <andrew@graven.com>
